LIST.summary: Lists blessed keys. Accepts NO-EVICT or no argument (default NO-EVICT); NONE is not listable (unblessed keys are untracked) and INRAM is unimplemented - both are a syntax error.
LIST.complexity: O(N) where N is the number of blessed keys.

reply_schema.description: Key names blessed at the requested level (default NO-EVICT).
